name: Jennea Cannon
summary: In Stormwind, Jennea Cannon guides new mages through their first studies. From the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter, she teaches caution and self-control, and investigates disturbances in local arcane energies.

sections.title: A Guide in the Sanctum
sections.body: At the top of the Wizard's Sanctum's spiral walkway, Jennea Cannon guides those who come to Stormwind to study the arcane. She teaches more than spells, insisting that students learn caution and self-control. Even those who do not study magic hear her warning: without training, magic can burn its wielder.

sections.title: Fieldwork and Foundation
sections.body: Jennea sends promising apprentices beyond the city walls to test what they have learned. At Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, they study how natural water sources meet arcane resonance. As they advance, she sends them to investigate disturbances at the Blue Recluse or gather volatile reagents for their first true wizard's implements.

sections.title: Ties to Greater Masters
sections.body: When an apprentice outgrows Jennea's lessons, she points the way to greater masters. Those who show true potential may continue up the Sanctum's hierarchy with High Sorcerer Andromath, or travel beyond the kingdom to practitioners such as Tabetha, deep in the Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.answer: Jennea Cannon guides new mages and directs early magical research from the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Where can I find Jennea Cannon?
faq.answer: You can find Jennea Cannon inside the Wizard's Sanctum, the spiral tower at the center of Stormwind City's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: What quests does Jennea Cannon offer?
faq.answer: Jennea offers Alliance mages early studies that include examining Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, investigating strange happenings at the Blue Recluse, and gathering materials for novice mage gear.

faq.q: Why does she send mages to Mirror Lake?
faq.answer: Jennea sends apprentices to fetch a sample from the base of Mirror Lake's waterfall so she can test it for magical taints. She fears altered magic around Stormwind and Elwynn may be seeping into the water.

faq.q: Does Jennea Cannon interact with non-mage classes?
aliases: can non mages talk to jennea
faq.answer: Non-mages can speak with Jennea, who warns them to be cautious around magic because it burns those without proper training.

faq.q: Who does Jennea Cannon report to?
faq.answer: Jennea guides students within the Wizard's Sanctum until they are ready to study with senior figures such as High Sorcerer Andromath.

angles.text: As a mage, you can look to Jennea for your first field investigations and guidance toward crafting your formal wizard robes and staff.
As an Alliance member, you can find Jennea in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, where she trains new sorcerers to serve the Alliance safely.
